of.needed: whether third-party old-style tc BPF users are present in the environment

consequence.statement: Cilium will attach tc BPF programs using tcx BPF links instead of old-style tc BPF attachment on Linux kernel 6.6+; if third-party old-style tc BPF users are present and bpf.enableTCX is not explicitly set to false, this behavioral switch may cause compatibility issues with those third-party tools.

assertion.statement: For Linux kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium 1.16.0 defaults to tcx BPF links for tc BPF program attachment instead of old-style tc BPF attachment; environments with third-party old-style tc BPF users can disable this via Helm value bpf.enableTCX=false to maintain backward compatibility.
